description.text: National Domestic Preparedness Consortium Reauthorization Act

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

bill.title: National Domestic Preparedness Consortium Reauthorization Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill reauthorizes and updates the National Domestic Preparedness Consortium, adds the Rural Domestic Preparedness Consortium and MxV Learning Institute, and renames certain member entries. It authorizes $111M–$125M for FY2027–2031, expands training to state, tribal, territorial and public‑safety partners, and preserves FY2023 minimum allocations with proportional distribution.

impact.summary: The bill reauthorizes the National Domestic Preparedness Consortium and adds the Academy of Counter‑Terrorist Education and Rural Domestic Preparedness Consortium. It authorizes FY2027–2031 consortium funding ($111M, $114M, $117M, $120M, $125M) and directs the Secretary of Homeland Security to preserve FY2023 funding or proportionally allocate cuts.
